summary: Validated fix for /api/admin/carteiras/{owner_id}/ajuste 500 error (ObjectId serialization) and header padding on /admin/carteiras. All 4 backend pytest cases pass (credit, debit, revert, insufficient balance 400, zero 400). UI test also confirmed: modal 'Ajustar saldo' applies credit successfully without 'Erro ao aplicar ajuste' — Diego saldo went 15.60 → 16.60 (then reverted). Header 'SUPER ADMIN / Carteiras & Preços' displays with proper padding on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844).
critical_code_review_comments: carteira_service.py is 575 lines — approaching split threshold; consider extracting alerta_saldo_baixo email logic into a separate module.
The fix (movimento.pop('_id', None) after insert_one) is applied inside _aplicar_movimento, so ALL callers (recarga, consumo, bonus, estorno, ajuste) benefit — good, no other similar leaks.
test_credentials: admin.qa@teste.com / Teste@123 (perfil=admin, plano=enterprise, email_verificado=true). Created via /api/auth/registro + direct Mongo update because it didn't exist despite being listed in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Recreated admin.qa@teste.com user in DB (was missing). Applied +1.00 ajuste to Diego's carteira via UI test then immediately reverted with -1.00. Final Diego saldo: R$ 15.60 (unchanged). Admin.qa carteira has some movimentos de teste from backend pytest (credit +1 / debit -1 self-cancelling, net zero).
context_for_next_testing_agent: admin.qa@teste.com now exists in DB with perfil=admin. Login returns 'access_token' (not 'token'). Ajuste endpoint working end-to-end (backend + frontend). Header padding on /admin/carteiras verified fine on both viewports.
rca of the issue: PyMongo insert_one() mutates the input dict by injecting the auto-generated _id (ObjectId) in-place. The service was returning that same dict, so FastAPI's JSON encoder hit a non-serializable ObjectId → 500 in the ajuste route. Fix: movimento.pop('_id', None) right after insert_one in _aplicar_movimento. Verified via pytest that response contains no '_id' key.
